scenario.zh: 为欧洲中年职场人士设计个性化预防健康方案，结合生物标志物与生活数据
scenario.en: Design a personalized preventive health plan for a European professional combining biomarkers and lifestyle data

instruction.zh: 确定用于生成健康洞察的输入数据类型
instruction.en: Choose input data types for generating health insights

label.zh: 基础血液标志物 + 问卷

output.zh: 方案聚焦脂质代谢与炎症指标，覆盖心血管与代谢系统
output.en: Plan focuses on lipid metabolism and inflammation markers covering cardiovascular and metabolic systems

label.zh: 完整生物标志物 + 可穿戴数据

output.zh: 方案整合 11 个身体系统与活动、睡眠、心率变异性数据
output.en: Plan integrates 11 body systems with activity, sleep, and heart rate variability data

instruction.zh: 选择首要关注的健康风险领域
instruction.en: Choose primary health risk area to address

output.zh: 方案强调血压管理、有氧运动与 omega-3 补充建议
output.en: Plan emphasizes blood pressure management, aerobic exercise, and omega-3 supplementation recommendations

output.zh: 方案强调胰岛素敏感性、间歇性禁食与力量训练建议
output.en: Plan emphasizes insulin sensitivity, intermittent fasting, and strength training recommendations

instruction.zh: 比较医生审核前后的行动建议差异
instruction.en: Compare action recommendations before and after physician review

output.zh: 建议包含 8 项行动：3 项饮食调整、2 项运动方案、3 项补充剂
output.en: Recommendations include 8 actions: 3 dietary adjustments, 2 exercise protocols, 3 supplements

output.zh: 建议精简至 5 项优先行动，移除 2 项补充剂，增加复查时间节点
output.en: Recommendations refined to 5 priority actions, 2 supplements removed, follow-up milestones added

instruction.zh: 确定个性化健康计划的最终呈现方式
instruction.en: Determine final presentation of personalized health plan

output.zh: 方案分为启动期、适应期与巩固期，每阶段含具体指标与行动清单
output.en: Plan divided into initiation, adaptation, and consolidation phases with specific metrics and action lists per phase

output.zh: 方案整合季度生物标志物复测节点与可穿戴数据趋势追踪
output.en: Plan integrates quarterly biomarker retesting checkpoints and wearable data trend tracking

takeaway.zh: 结合深度生物标志物与医生审核，输出可执行的分阶段健康干预计划
takeaway.en: Combine deep biomarkers with physician review to output actionable phased health intervention plans

initial.zh: 目标：降低心血管风险，改善代谢健康。基线：血脂偏高，久坐工作，睡眠不足。
initial.en: Goal: reduce cardiovascular risk, improve metabolic health. Baseline: elevated lipids, sedentary work, insufficient sleep.
